usageNotes: Use this to list all QEMU VMs across a registered PDM remote (or on a specific node within that remote). Omitting the `node` parameter queries every node in the cluster, which is the preferred way to get a full inventory. The caller must hold `Resource.Audit` on the remote resource path; live runtime fields (cpu, mem, disk I/O, pressure stats) are only populated for running VMs.

examples.summary: List all QEMU VMs across every node on the 'hetzner-pve' remote

tips: Filter by `status` in the response to quickly isolate stopped vs. running VMs without a separate call.
The `template` boolean field lets you exclude template VMs from inventory counts.
Pressure stall fields (pressurecpufull, pressureiofull, pressurememoryfull) are Linux PSI metrics — only present on kernels that expose /proc/pressure.
Use the `node` query param to scope results to a single node if the cluster is large, reducing response size and remote API load.
